queue.what: On-demand marketplace for same-day courier, last-mile and middle-mile delivery using independent drivers nationwide, with an API for high-volume shippers.
Tech-enabled same-day and final-mile freight delivery network, covering 21 markets and about 70% of the U.S. population.
On-demand same-day courier platform matching shippers with driver partners across NYC, Long Island, Westchester and northern and central New Jersey.
Route-planning and dispatch software for couriers and delivery drivers, with a driver app downloaded by over 10 million drivers and over a billion deliveries supported in 2024.
Delivery-as-a-service orchestration platform that gives businesses white-label dispatch across hundreds of delivery providers such as DoorDash and Uber, with about $14.8M raised.
